with sh as (select f.id from files f where f.mime_type='application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet' and f.trashed=0 and exists (select 1 from permissions p where p.file_id=f.id and p.role<>'owner' and coalesce(p.deleted,0)=0)), cl as (select sh.id, case when exists (select 1 from cells c where c.spreadsheet_id=sh.id and replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(c.value_text),' ',''),'_',''),'#',''),'-',''),'.',''),':',''),'/',''),'(',''),')',''),'''',''),'?',''),'*','') in ('client', 'clientdob', 'dateofbirth', 'dob', 'medicalrecordnumber', 'mrn', 'patientdob', 'patientname', 'ssn')) then 'Restricted'
 when exists (select 1 from cells c where c.spreadsheet_id=sh.id and replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(c.value_text),' ',''),'_',''),'#',''),'-',''),'.',''),':',''),'/',''),'(',''),')',''),'''',''),'?',''),'*','') in ('customeremail', 'email', 'emailaddress', 'owneremail', 'personalemail')) then 'Confidential' else 'Internal' end as tier from sh), ros(email,dept,phi,tr) as (values ('alex.chen@healthpii.example','Clinical Operations','Yes','2025-06-12'), ('avery.brooks@healthpii.example','Growth','No',null), ('avery.taylor@healthpii.example','Growth','Yes','2025-01-20'), ('cameron.shaw@healthpii.example','Clinical Operations','Yes','2025-04-01'), ('casey.rivers@healthpii.example','Engineering','No',null), ('diana.reyes@healthpii.example','Clinical Operations','Yes','2025-03-30'), ('drew.martin@healthpii.example','Finance','Yes','2025-11-03'), ('jamie.ross@healthpii.example','Operations','Yes','2025-09-18'), ('jordan.smith@healthpii.example','Growth','No','2025-08-01'), ('lee.anderson@healthpii.example','Finance','No',null), ('morgan.blake@healthpii.example','Finance','Yes',null), ('nico.vasquez@healthpii.example','Clinical Operations','Yes','2025-12-09'), ('phoenix.wright@healthpii.example','Product','No',null), ('quinn.pemberton@healthpii.example','Clinical Operations','Yes','2025-10-21'), ('riley.nguyen@healthpii.example','Engineering','Yes','2024-11-15'), ('river.cohen@healthpii.example','Clinical Operations','Yes','2026-01-14'), ('sage.patel@healthpii.example','Growth','Yes','2025-07-07'), ('sam.okonkwo@healthpii.example','Finance','No',null), ('sky.adams@healthpii.example','Operations','No',null), ('taylor.kim@healthpii.example','Product','No',null)), exc(title,email,role,expires) as (values ('08-18-25 - Patient demographics','jamie.ross@healthpii.example','commenter','2026-06-30'), ('Birth Sanctuary October 2025','diana.reyes@healthpii.example','commenter','2026-02-28'), ('M&A Conversation & Outbound Tracker','jamie.ross@healthpii.example','commenter','2026-12-31'), ('ACOG leads 2024','avery.taylor@healthpii.example','writer','2026-04-30'), ('ACOG leads 2024','sky.adams@healthpii.example','writer','2026-03-31'), ('Health-tech-founders','jamie.ross@healthpii.example','writer','2026-09-30'), ('Untitled spreadsheet(1)','drew.martin@healthpii.example','writer','2026-12-31'), ('Nurse Nikki  Greenaway - Contacts Export - 20240307 - Nikki Greenaway','sage.patel@healthpii.example','reader','2026-05-15'), ('Prattville Midwifery August 2025','alex.chen@healthpii.example','writer','2026-01-31'), ('[External Founders] Main Tracking List - Investor Database - Q3 Q4 2025','sky.adams@healthpii.example','writer','2026-08-31')),
g as (select p.id pid, p.file_id fid, p.type, p.role, p.email_address em, cl.tier, f.name title from permissions p join cl on cl.id=p.file_id join files f on f.id=p.file_id where p.role<>'owner' and coalesce(p.deleted,0)=0),
a as (select g.*, case when g.tier='Internal' then 9
  when g.type in ('anyone','domain') then 0
  else max(
   case when g.tier='Restricted' then (case when exists (select 1 from ros where ros.email=g.em and ros.phi='Yes' and ros.tr is not null and julianday('2026-03-31')-julianday(ros.tr)<=365) then 1 else 0 end)
        else (case when exists (select 1 from ros where ros.email=g.em and ros.dept='Growth') then 3 when exists (select 1 from ros where ros.email=g.em) then 1 else 0 end) end,
   coalesce((select max((case exc.role when 'reader' then 1 when 'commenter' then 2 when 'writer' then 3 else 0 end)) from exc where exc.title=g.title and exc.email=g.em and exc.expires>='2026-03-31'),0)) end as allowed from g) select (select count(*) from permissions where coalesce(deleted,0)=0) - (select count(*) from a where allowed=0)
